A 24 year old woman comes to the physician for advice regarding birth control. She has been sexually active since the age of 19 and has had multiple sexual partners. She has tried the oral contraceptive pill twice, for approximately two cycles each time, but stopped because of irregular bleeding. She has had gonorrhea once and Chlamydia twice, which resolved by antibiotic treatment. Which of the following forms of birth control should be recommended for this patient?
a) Condoms 
 b) Norplant
c) Intrauterine device 
 d) Oral contraceptive pill

c) Intrauterine contraceptive device

A 52-year-old woman comes with complain of hot flashes. Her last menstrual period was 1 year ago. Over the past year, she has noted a persistence of her hot flashes, which come several times and are associated with a feeling of heat and flushing. They also awaken her at night and interfere with her sleep. She has no medical problems, takes no medications, and has no known drug allergies. She is started on estrogen and medroxyprogesterone acetate .The addition of a progestin is most likely to decrease her risk of which of the following? 
a)Breast cancer 
b)Breast pain 
c)Endometrial cancer 
d)Weight gain

A 21-year-old sexually active woman presents with 3 cauliflower-like lesions on the right labia majora, which are painless. She has no medical problems, takes no medications, and has no allergies to medication. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
a) Acyclovir local application 
 b) Acetic acid local application
c) Cone biopsy 
 d) Cryotherapy
